decisions.reason: The hand-knotted wool silk carpet is a premium craftsmanship piece that suits a long-term collection, though carpet ranges do get refreshed, as the 2024 withdrawals showed.
The corner bench extends the core furniture range for residential and hospitality projects and remains a stable part of the offer.
The low-pile carpet resembles the decorative carpets already withdrawn, which raises the risk of a collection refresh, but it still complements the range at low cost.
The multi-model swivel shell chair line is tied to designer collaborations and contract markets, making it a durable investment.
